record_type: Retrospective record of executed methods, not a preregistration.

main.sampling: New remote calls without historical response-cache reuse. The simulation seed is not passed as a provider sampling seed.
main.identity_scope: Requested and returned service identifiers do not lock remote model weights. Event logs do not independently establish provider weight versions or call dates.
main.fault_policy: Exclude partial, failed, or heuristic-fallback runs. Use zero-fallback completed replacement runs for the three fault keys.

observation_endpoint.rule: rescue_min + rescue_window, or 150 minutes when rescue_min is null
observation_endpoint.early_stop: At an assessment check when every agent is evacuated, rescued, or deceased.
observation_endpoint.step_note: The loop evaluates times from zero up to, but not including, the configured endpoint. Physical updates use a 10 second step.

physical_rules.inlet_initial_seepage: Depth grows linearly from zero at minute 0 to 0.03 m at minute 5.
physical_rules.timer_rule: Accumulates only while stranded above the individual depth proxy. It is distinct from general wet exposure and does not reset.
rescue_order: instantaneously transfer reachable active agents without consuming extraction capacity
assess unreachable stranded agents using current depth OR cumulative fatality timer
extract reachable stranded agents using available capacity, deeper agents first
physical_rules.outside_window_fatality: Stranded agents: current depth above proxy OR cumulative fatality timer at least 600 s.
physical_rules.finalizer: Remaining stranded agents: current depth above proxy only.

outcomes.rescued: Instantaneous guided transfer plus completed capacity-limited extraction.

ablation.order: ON before OFF within a model, scenario, and seed block. Order was not randomized.
ablation.switch: OFF passes an empty retrieved knowledge list. Prompts, profiles, physical rules and decision intervals remain unchanged.

sensitivity.fine: 10 second rescue and fatality checks with capacity accrual proportional to elapsed time.
sensitivity.walk: Explicit guided walking on the FINE clock. Its endpoint rules additionally assess unreachable active agents and the cumulative timer of stranded agents.

statistics.cluster: Resample whole scenarios retaining their six repeats.

record_retention.published: Aggregated outcomes, process summaries, exit-time histograms, prompts, knowledge inputs and offline scripts.
record_retention.not_published: Formal engine, runners and per-event request/response transcripts.
record_retention.local_logs: Retained decision-event metadata do not contain full raw requests, raw responses, commitment histories or complete retry usage.
